P01.rationale: No founder or person portrait appears anywhere on this page; it contains only text and a blank rectangle.

P05.rationale: There are no case study portraits at all—only a generic placeholder box with no client image.

P07.rationale: No social-proof apparatus such as press logos, ratings, or testimonials is present on the page.

P10.rationale: No oversized decorative typographic elements like ghost numerals or large quote glyphs appear anywhere.

P11.rationale: There are no real data-visualisations bound to numbers—only a blank rectangle where one might be expected.

P12.rationale: The page is extremely sparse and under-filled, with vast empty space and minimal content.

P13.rationale: The background is flat blankness with no intentional texture or atmosphere appropriate to the page type.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used at all, so this criterion does not apply—but even if it were, there’s no treatment visible.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone/laptop/book) is shown anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The imagery consists entirely of a blank rectangle and no real photos—maximally generic by default due to absence of specificity.

N08.rationale: The page is dominated by large empty regions with no content—extreme dead whitespace.

N10.rationale: No text sits on a busy photo without scrim because there are no photos at all to create such an issue.
